plan.title: Liver drug-treated vs control DE + GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative: The inputs are a raw integer gene-level count matrix (12,000 genes x 6 samples, /data/inputs/counts/counts.csv, first column gene symbol) produced by STAR alignment and featureCounts, plus a 6-row sample table (/data/inputs/metadata/metadata.csv) with one condition column. The design is 3 drug-treated vs 3 control human liver samples, unpaired, single batch. Because the counts are already gene-level integers from featureCounts, they go into the negative-binomial model as they are: no length correction and no tximport (the counts are not transcript-level abundances, so a transcript-import path would be wrong here). The plan is: (T1S1) sample-structure QC on a blind VST — library sizes, PCA on the 500 most variable genes, sample-distance heatmap — to see whether the two groups separate and whether either of the three-replicate groups holds an outlier, before any test runs; (T1S2) minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in at least 3 samples, the smallest group size), DESeq2 with design ~condition, control set explicitly as the reference level so a positive log2 fold change means higher in treated, Wald test, apeglm shrinkage of the treated-vs-control coefficient, BH adjustment at alpha 0.05 with independent filtering left on, and an edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test on the same filtered matrix as a robustness check whose intersection with the DESeq2 calls is the high-confidence set; (T2S1) fgsea preranked GSEA on the full ranked list of tested genes using the DESeq2 Wald statistic against the human MSigDB Hallmark collection, followed by GO Biological Process — the ranked method rather than over-representation, because with n=3 per group the significant list is likely to be far shorter than the ~50 genes an over-representation test needs; (T1S3) the assembled report with fit diagnostics, both fold-change columns, the two-method overlap, an explicit statement of the power limit at three replicates per group, and the reproducibility record. The dominant caveat throughout is power: at 3 vs 3 the count models recover only a minority of true differential expression, weighted toward large fold changes, so absence from the significant list is not evidence that a gene is unchanged. The thresholds stay at their defaults rather than being loosened to compensate.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes
Minimal pre-filter: >=10 counts in at least 3 samples
~ condition with explicit reference level control, contrast condition treated vs control, raw integer counts, no tximport
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then GO BP
Reproducibility report: MA plot, dispersion plot, p-value histogram, gene tables with shrunken and unshrunken LFC, power statement, sessionInfo

Present the gene table with baseMean, unshrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange, Wald stat, pvalue and padj, ranked by the shrunken fold change, with the shrinkage estimator named in the header. Report the DESeq2/edgeR overlap and label the intersection the high-confidence set. For the enrichment, give the collection and version, the rank metric, the universe, the size window, the collapsed significant sets with their leading-edge genes, and the caveat that enrichment results are method-dependent. Close with the reproducibility record: sessionInfo, all package versions, the seeds used, the gene-set collection version, and the annotation release.
steps.context: This is the deliverable that answers the research question. Its main risk is over-claiming from a 3-vs-3 design, so the power statement and the two-method overlap carry as much weight as the gene list itself.
acceptance_criteria: Power statement at 3 replicates per group appears before the gene tables
Method, package versions, design formula, contrast direction, thresholds, number of genes tested after filtering, and number of DE genes all stated
MA plot, dispersion plot, and p-value histogram included with a sentence on what each shows
Gene table carries unshrunken log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange, and lfcSE, ranked by the shrunken value, with the estimator named
DESeq2 vs edgeR counts and intersection reported; intersection labelled high-confidence, union not presented as the result
Enrichment section states collection, version, rank metric (Wald statistic), universe (tested genes), size window, and lists leading-edge genes per reported set
Reproducibility record with sessionInfo, package versions, seeds, and collection version stored with the results
constraints: Rank genes and draw plots on the shrunken log2 fold change; keep the p-values from the unshrunken fit
Do not present enrichment hits as established mechanism — they are hypotheses for follow-up
Do not report the union of DESeq2 and edgeR as the result set
State the number of NA padj genes from independent filtering separately from the Cook's outlier NAs
No conclusion may claim a gene is unchanged on the basis of its absence from the significant list
caveats: If the DE list is empty or near-empty, that is a legitimate result at this sample size and must be reported as such rather than rescued by loosening thresholds
featureCounts strandedness and multi-mapping settings are not in the profiled inputs; if they cannot be recovered, record them as unknown rather than assuming a default
